maxUploadBytes.description: Maximum accepted size in bytes for a single uploaded artefact (tarball or raw file).

maxDecompressedBytes.description: Maximum accepted decompressed size in bytes for an uploaded npm tarball. Caps tar-bomb potential independent of the compressed upload size.

maxTarEntries.description: Maximum number of entries (files + directories) accepted in an uploaded npm tarball. Pre-installed node_modules can easily exceed the lower legacy default.

enabled.description: Enable advisory vulnerability scanning of npm artefacts via osv-scanner. Off by default so deployments without the binary keep working.

osvScannerPath.description: Path or command name of the osv-scanner v2 binary.

dbDir.description: Local directory holding the offline OSV vulnerability database.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of artefact scans running at once in this process.

rescanIntervalHours.description: Interval in hours between automatic rescans of all npm artefacts (also refreshes the OSV DB).

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-artefact scan timeout in seconds (extraction + osv-scanner).

rootDir.description: Optional root directory (key prefix) under which all objects are stored in the bucket. Lets a single bucket be shared between deployments.

downloadUrlExpirySeconds.description: Expiry in seconds for S3 presigned download URLs issued by the /download and /tarball routes.
